clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, Hex of Weakness carries a young Darkspear priest from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Tai'jin sends an initiate north to Ur'kyo, who welcomes new students into the tribe's spiritual circle and teaches the loa's darker arts.

Young Darkspear priests continue their lessons in Razor Hill's barracks under Tai'jin's watch. Once an acolyte shows command of spiritual communion and shadow magic, the first lessons end. Tai'jin sends the promising priest north, across Durotar's red dirt canyons, toward the Horde capital. There, elder practitioners guide the tribe's wider magical traditions.

The Darkspear keep a distinct cultural sanctuary in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, apart from the orcs' clanging forges and warrior grounds. Ur'kyo, an elder priest, waits there for new initiates. Joining his circle means embracing the ancestral traditions of the jungle trolls: honoring the loa while learning potent curses and hexes that sap an enemy's strength in battle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It be time for you to meet with Ur'kyo, friend. He be in the Valley of Spirits in the orc city. Go there and speak to him. It is time you learn more of the old ways of our kind. It time you be brought into the circle and made a true priest of our tribe.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.
